mLocKeys.keySummary: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Taric projects a beam of starlight, bursting after @ChargeDuration@ second to deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stun</status> enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: After using an Ability, Taric's next 2 Attacks within @Duration@ seconds gain <attackSpeed>100% Attack Speed</attackSpeed>, deal an additional <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, and reduce his basic Ability Cooldowns by @CDR@ second.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Gain a stack (max @MaxCharges@) every @StackCooldown@ seconds and when hitting a Bravado Attack.

Active: Consume all stacks to restore @HealingPerStack@ Health per stack to nearby ally champions (@MaxStackHealing@ at @MaxCharges@ stacks).

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Cosmic Radiance</titleLeft><mainText>Taric has made this unit temporarily invulnerable.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Taric calls down protection from the heavens. After @InitialDelay@ seconds, nearby ally champions become invulnerable for @InvulnDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Bastion Shield</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is temporarily shielded from damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.

Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Taric gains @BonusArmor@ Armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by this Ability. As long as they are near each other, the ally gains @BonusArmor@ Armor and Taric casts all his Abilities from both himself and his linked ally.

Active: Taric binds to an ally champion, granting a @ShieldHPRatio@% max Health Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Mimicked spell effects do not stack.
Only one ally can be bound at a time.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Bastion</titleLeft><mainText>While near Taric, this unit has increased Armor and has Taric's spells cast off of it.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
